_readme: Client wiring for the two MCP servers the Pack uses. Copy to .mcp.json in your own project
(or register them with your client) and keep only what you installed.
dayzmake: dayzmake's own MCP server (https://github.com/bzed/dayzmake, >= 3.1.0): script-API,
script-body and config look-ups, source extraction and the PBO, config, key, PAA and binarize
commands. Install and verify the binary as in skills/dayz-pbo-build/references/dayzmake-linux.md
(it lands in ~/.local/bin/dayzmake), check '<path> --version' prints v3.1.0 or later, and put that
absolute path in 'command' (JSON does not expand ~ or $HOME): the bare name 'dayzmake' would run
whatever build the client's PATH finds first. Guide: skills/_shared/dayzmake-mcp.md.
dayz-mcp: DayZ-MCP (https://github.com/willy92wins/dayz-mcp), the in-game bridge described in
knowledge/dayz-mcp-bridge-protocol.md. Clone that repo and run tools/install-mcp.ps1
-Register; it creates tools/.venv-mcp and registers this exact shape. Set 'command' to that
Deliberately NOT named .mcp.json: agents auto-start servers declared there, and a
failed launch on every session is worse than no config.
MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS raises the per-tool output cap so screenshots come back at a
usable resolution; at the 25k default a frame lands around 580 px wide.
